brief:
The United States has continued providing military assistance and arms transfers to Israel throughout the three-year Gaza conflict, even as American public opinion toward the war has shifted, Al Jazeera English reported. The aid flow has remained consistent despite mounting civilian casualties and international calls for restrictions on weapons shipments.

The military support persists alongside growing American public criticism of Israel's operations in Gaza. American voters have turned more skeptical of the war, yet the administration has not altered its aid levels in response.
dek: US military aid and arms transfer continue unchanged, as US public sentiment shifts.
title: US maintains military aid flow to Israel despite Gaza war
